kitchen_K2.exact_task_instruction: Prepare and serve coffee and soup for two people using the available kitchenware. Stir both coffees and provide each soup bowl with a suitable utensil. Search closed kitchen storage for anything still required.

living_L1.exact_task_instruction: Prepare the living room for two people watching television: put one cup and saucer on each personal support and the remote on a shared support.

workshop_W1.exact_task_instruction: Find a compatible screw and driver, insert the screw tip-down into the workbench repair hole, drive it fully, and return the driver safely.
